summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, solely to announce the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The filing contains no special-situation event: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The Form 6-K is a routine filing requirement for foreign private issuers under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms or extraordinary corporate actions are present.
